query: What specific pilot recruitment, consent, and nonresponse protocols and diagnostics will detect positive-selection bias and define criteria to move to a phased scale-up?

response.query: What specific pilot recruitment, consent, and nonresponse protocols and diagnostics will detect positive-selection bias and define criteria to move to a phased scale-up?
response.answer: Pilot recruitment protocols should use random sampling to avoid bias, consent must be informed and voluntary, and nonresponse diagnostics should include statistical analysis to detect selection bias before scaling up.

Message to the Quality Payment Program listserv on January 3, 2023, entitled: “The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) is Soliciting Stakeholder Recommendations for Potential Consideration of New Specialty Measure Sets and/or Revisions to the Existing Specialty Measure Sets for the 2024 Performance Year of the Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS).”. *https://www.cms.gov/​Medicare/​Medicare-Feefor-Service-Payment/​sharedsavingsprogram/​about*. *https://www.cms.gov/​Medicare/​Medicare-Fee-for-Service-Part-B-Drugs/​McrPartBDrugAvgSalesPrice.*. For example, see the final rule published in the **Federal Register** on November 18, 2022 (87 FR 69404), titled Medicare and Medicaid Programs; CY 2023 Payment Policies Under the Physician Fee Schedule and Other Changes to Part B Payment and Coverage Policies; Medicare Shared Savings Program Requirements; Implementing Requirements for Manufacturers of Certain Single-dose Container or Single-use Package Drugs To Provide Refunds With Respect to Discarded Amounts; and COVID-19 Interim Final Rules”.
